production_model: Made in the USA in small batches
notes: Store description (meta.json, homepage): 'in 2009 we set up shop in Nashville, TN, forever on the quest to make the perfect jeans. made in the USA. free returns & exchanges + free shipping on all domestic orders'.

Our story: first fits were 'imogene (for women) and willie (for men)'; shop opened in an old service station in Nashville in 2009; later 'constructed our own sewing room in los angeles, opened a second home in austin' (https://imogeneandwillie.com/pages/our-story).

Made in USA page: 'to make all of our clothing in the usa'; small-batch production; in-house sewing team of 12; fabric partners named: Mt. Vernon Mills (US mill), Martin Farms (regenerative cotton, Alabama), Stony Creek Colors (plant-based natural indigo, near Nashville) (https://imogeneandwillie.com/pages/made-in-usa).

Returns: full-price online items within 30 days for refund, exchange or store credit; refunds carry a $12 processing fee; exchanges free; sale items final; custom-inseam alterations final (https://imogeneandwillie.com/policies/refund-policy).

Shipping: free on all domestic orders (meta/homepage); domestic via USPS; international orders accepted, customer pays duties (https://imogeneandwillie.com/pages/our-policies). Shopify ships_to_countries: ['*','CA','US'] (rest of world zone), so CA, GB, AU recorded.
Stores: Nashville (2601 12th Ave S) and Austin (1401 S Congress Ave); in-store guided fittings and complimentary chainstitch hemming (https://imogeneandwillie.com/pages/locations).

Tailor shop: complimentary chainstitch hems on all pants; denim repair: free repairs for one year on I+W jeans, hardware (zippers, buttons, rivets) free for life (https://imogeneandwillie.com/pages/denim-repair).
Sizes (products.json options): women's jeans waists 23–36; men's 27–40 (27–36, 38, 40). A 'women's denim - extended inseam' collection (27 products) exists; has_tall left null.
Collab: i+w x Wrangler capsule no. 2 on the homepage banner ('Made in USA collaboration').

Stockists page lists ~40 US shops (e.g. Blue Owl Seattle, Stag Provisions Nashville/Dallas/Austin, Snake Oil Provisions LA, Totem Brand Co. Philadelphia, Ford General Chicago) (https://imogeneandwillie.com/pages/stockists).
